In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the symbiotic activity is due to an increased DP and level of production of the modified KPS, which is in part lipid-free and in part lipidated.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the rkpZ gene is involved in the overproduction and increased molecular mass of polyKdo, which is sufficient to replace succinoglycans during symbiosis with host plants.
the symbiotic activity conferred by the rkpZ gene is based on the overproduction of a modified KPS, which has increased DP and a lower level of lipid modification.
the Rm1021 KPS is modified by the introduction of rkpZ, which leads to an overproduction of a modified polyKdo with a high DP.

the rkpZ gene of Rm41 is able to modify the wild-type poly Kdo by overproduction and by increased molecular weight.
